name: chatgpt-product-feed-for-shop
description: Puts your shop in front of ChatGPT. Serves a product feed in the format OpenAI's merchant tools ask for, in which every variation is its own product - its own price, photos, stock and link - grouped under its listing, so someone asking ChatGPT for the exact size and colour finds the exact size and colour you sell. Give ChatGPT the address once; the feed is built fresh from the shop every time it is collected, so it never disagrees with your prices. Anything that would be turned away - no photo, no brand - is held back and listed for you to fix.
